subject: [PATCH v4 02/13] mm/khugepaged: count collapses where khugepaged makes them

2026-09-28.patch_summary: This patch modifies the khugepaged functionality to count collapses where it makes them, rather than relying on the caller to increment a shared counter. The daemon can now keep its own counter without needing to test who called the collapse function. This change simplifies the code and improves maintainability.
